title: 東京都給水条例 (Tokyo Metropolitan Water Supply Ordinance), Showa 33 Ordinance No. 41, as amended to Reiwa 7 Ordinance No. 128
archive_note: The Bureau's site refuses automated fetching, so this is a browser print-to-PDF of the ordinance as published in the Bureau's own 例規集. Under the capture rules that is the stronger capture available, and it is the instrument rather than a description of it.
establishes: Art. 23: the charge is (basic charge + volumetric charge) x 110/100, with fractions of a yen truncated. The multiplier is set by the ordinance itself, not inferred from a worked example.
Art. 23-2: the basic charge by bore. 13 mm 860 yen, 20 mm 1,170 yen, 25 mm 1,460 yen a month.

Art. 23-3: the volumetric table for bores of 25 mm and under. Above 5 m3 to 10 m3, 22 yen/m3; above 10 to 20, 128; above 20 to 30, 163; above 30 to 50, 202; above 50 to 100, 213; above 100 to 200, 298; above 200 to 1,000, 372; above 1,000, 404.

That the first 5 m3 a month carries no volumetric charge for bores of 25 mm and under, because the table begins above 5 m3 — a basic volume inside the basic charge rather than a zero-rated first tier.
Art. 28: billing is bi-monthly by default, monthly where the manager determines it.
Art. 30: the statutory reductions, which are means- and status-tested and therefore outside the benchmark under Rule 3.1.
does_not_establish: The sewerage table, which is levied by the Bureau of Sewerage under a different instrument and is read here from the ready-reckoner.
The summer basic-charge waiver, which is a temporary measure outside the ordinance.
Which bore the ordinary single dwelling has. The ordinance prices twelve bores and designates none.
